policy.pointing: Only the user-supplied Accordance text supplies pointing; open positions retain original unpointed Digital Mishnah text.
policy.analysis: Existing candidates retained; missing analyses transferred through unique interlinear positions with consonantal or explicitly documented spelling compatibility. Five rashai positions additionally checked against Levy. No morphology inferred from pointing.
policy.translation: Existing editorial glosses remain conditional on unverified analyses; rabbinic dictionary links only.
policy.manuscript: Original source characters, corrections, raw TEI and image observations remain unchanged.
